requirement: Commercially available, cloud-native, web-based LMS covering the full lifecycle on one platform
gap: Lifecycle exists on one platform, but no paying lender, and no production deployment anywhere (CLAUDE.md: no deploy path, no live users).

requirement: Offered version generally available and live at a bank or regulated institution at bid closing; no beta
evidence: None for CredaFlow. Ndzinga Capital runs ndzinga-lms, the parent codebase, not the offered version (no LS jurisdiction, IFRS 9, matrix or SSO work).
gap: CredaFlow has no live lender. Parent reference is a different version. Needs Fair Score's live LMS client, or a yes to clarification Q7.

requirement: Parameter-driven products: personal, salary-backed, SME, group, asset finance, mortgage, revolving
evidence: settings/products/loan; ProductType enum (prisma/schema/loans-payments.prisma) has MICRO, PERSONAL, PO_FUNDING, ASSET_FINANCE only
gap: Main has 2 of 7 types. After #280 check-off, SME, group and revolving are Partial per its own table; mortgage is not built.

requirement: Per-product rate type, fees, tenor, limits, frequency, grace, collateral, eligibility
gap: Stored and versioned, but collateral and eligibility are not enforced (lib/product-engine/.claude.md, still so on #280 branch). Variable rate only with #280.

requirement: Product versioning with effective dates and maker-checker on every change
evidence: ProductVersion plus guard triggers; lib/maker-checker; lib/product-engine/activate.ts
gap: Main: an unversioned product is created or edited directly by one ADMIN. #280 adds the second person at route level (no DB trigger on LoanProduct). Loan products only, insurance products not covered.

requirement: Pricing rules by segment, risk grade, channel and campaign
gap: Segment, channel and campaign work. Risk grade is stripped from every key-facts application with no bureau check (lib/decisioning/key-facts-referral.ts), so it cannot price on an LS demo until #291, and then only with the simulated bureau.

requirement: Capture from branch, internet banking, mobile app, agents and employer portals, with save-and-resume
gap: No employer portal. No bank-channel integration. Save-and-resume is browser localStorage on the public funnel, not a server draft a borrower can resume on another device.

requirement: Core-banking customer retrieval by API; new capture; KYC and AML (sanctions, PEP) screening before approval
gap: No core banking API. lib/screening/.claude.md: only the simulated screening provider exists, and a real key-facts lender cannot decide without a provider. REST deviation.

requirement: Document upload, scanning, indexing; mandatory-document checklist per product
gap: Checklists are KYC-wide and fixed for asset finance, not configurable per product. Financial statements are an asset-finance type only.

requirement: Pre-qualification and calculator with key facts disclosure before submission
evidence: lib/qualify.ts; lib/loan-calculator.ts; lib/non-nca-documents; PASQ on ZA
gap: Main shows LS key facts at signing, after submission. #289 adds a required indicative statement at submission (application-code gate). Wording is SAMPLE.

requirement: Collateral and guarantor capture; collateral register with valuation dates, insurance details, expiry alerts
evidence: Asset, AssetValuation, SuretyConsent in prisma/schema/asset-finance.prisma; lib/valuation-guides
gap: Asset-finance only. No guarantor or collateral on personal, SME or check-off loans (grep for guarantor in schema: none). No insurance or valuation expiry alert.

requirement: Application tracking: status, ageing and turnaround per stage, with notifications
gap: Timeline and level SLAs exist. No ageing or turnaround-per-stage view or report.

requirement: Sales pipeline for loan officers with duplicate application detection
evidence: app/(dashboard)/crm (kanban, opportunities, queue); lib/crm/lead-dedup.ts; crm/leads/[id]/duplicates; open-application index
gap: None for the line. Show in screenshots.

requirement: Business-configurable rules engine: eligibility, policy, knock-outs, limits
gap: Default OFF per lender. A JSON/form rule editor is not the 2.9.5 drag-and-drop designer.

requirement: Configurable application and behavioural scorecards per product, bands to grades and pricing
gap: Application scorecard only. No behavioural scorecard exists. Grade is cleared on LS with no bureau check.

requirement: Automated bureau enquiries by API; report and score stored
gap: South African adapters only. No Lesotho bureau adapter and none named by the Bank; ZA bureaus are not called for key-facts lenders.

requirement: Affordability: disposable income and DTI from payslip, statement and obligations, configurable, incl. max check-off deduction
evidence: lib/affordability; lib/loan-calculator.ts NDI; dtiPct fact in lib/decisioning/facts.ts; lib/statement-analysis
gap: Works, but no maximum-permitted-deduction rule for check-off. Debts on LS are self-declared with no bureau.

requirement: Automated approve, decline or refer with a reason code on every decision
gap: Reason codes hold. On main every LS approval refers to staff. #291 makes it demoable, simulated bureau only. Real decline needs s71-style sign-off.

requirement: Manual override restricted to roles, with mandatory reason and audit
evidence: lib/decisioning/human-review.ts (reason min length); decide route; lib/audit.ts; compliance/bureau-overrides
gap: None material.

requirement: Simulation of rule and scorecard changes on history; champion/challenger
gap: Simulation is indicative (module note). Needs seeded history in the demo.

requirement: SME credit appraisal report with financial statement spreading and ratio analysis
evidence: None. Grep for spreading, ratio analysis and appraisal finds nothing relevant.
gap: Not built.

requirement: Instant decisioning of digital applications within 60 seconds
evidence: digital-decisions cron and lib/decisioning/digital-due.ts for the mechanism
gap: Main refers every digital LS application. #291 measures 367 ms with the simulated bureau only; a real lender has no Lesotho bureau, and new borrowers wait for staff KYC.

requirement: Multi-level approval by amount, product, grade, branch; maker-checker, delegation, escalation
evidence: lib/approval; settings/approval-matrix; cron approval-escalations; DB chain guard
gap: Main: approver authority is not branch-scoped, and the application page answers 500 on a lender with a matrix (fixed in #289 and #292). Grade rules need a grade (see 2.1.4).

requirement: Credit committee packs; recording of decisions and conditions
gap: Pack and decisions exist, but the same page crash applies and conditions are neither shown nor enforced on main.

requirement: Offer letters, agreements and key facts from templates, with electronic acceptance
gap: Main has key facts and agreement, no offer letter. All Lesotho wording is SAMPLE until the Bank's legal team supplies it.

requirement: Tracking of conditions precedent before disbursement
gap: Main has fixed preconditions and an asset-finance checklist, no general per-application conditions. #292 enforces committee conditions at signing and payout; condition staged on UNDER_REVIEW only in its browser check.

requirement: Full, partial and tranche disbursement in real time to core banking, or to third parties
gap: Nothing moves money on LS: staff record a manual reference. No core API, no tranches, no partial, no settlement of other lenders' loans. Core settlement is a REST deviation.

requirement: Automatic deduction of upfront fees, premiums and settlements at disbursement
gap: Upfront fee is deducted. No general premium deduction. Settlement of own loans comes with #281 (manual payout); other lenders' loans not covered.

requirement: Maker-checker authorisation of disbursements, blocked until CPs are met
evidence: lib/security/segregation-of-duties.ts; disburse route; second_person AvsCheck on LS
gap: Second person and fixed preconditions hold; general CPs need #292. SoD is a lender setting, must be on.

requirement: Flat, reducing, amortising, bullet, balloon, interest-only; fixed and variable rates with auto repricing
gap: Main lacks balloon and variable consumer loans. #280 adds both, but says booking through the disburse route is unproven, and it is CONFLICTING against main.

requirement: Schedules accurate to 2 decimals, regenerated after any change
evidence: lib/product-engine/schedule.ts plus schedule.test.ts; integer cents; DB reconcile
gap: Accuracy holds. Regeneration after a loan change does not exist on main outside asset finance.

requirement: Repayment: core debits, check-off files, mobile money, digital, branch
evidence: PaymentMethod enum (EFT, CASH, DEBIT_ORDER, CARD, WAIVER); lib/bank-sync CSV; lib/collections-engine (ZA DebiCheck)
gap: No core debit, no check-off import or matching, no mobile money (grep: zero hits). #280 adds only a deduction list export. LS repayment is EFT. REST deviation.

requirement: Configurable allocation order; overpayments and advance payments
gap: Order is system-driven (lib/manual/curriculum.ts says so), not configurable. Overpayment sits UNAPPLIED for refund.

requirement: Early settlement and partial prepayment, with quotes valid to a stated date
gap: Settlement figure as of a date exists. No issued quotation with a validity date for consumer loans (lease termination quote only). No partial prepayment function.

requirement: Reschedule, restructure, top-up, refinance, consolidate, holidays, rate/term change with approval and history
gap: Not on main. #281 does all eight on KEY_FACTS loans; top-up payout manual, nothing sent to the borrower, needs legal sign-off.

requirement: Daily interest accrual, penalty interest, recurring fees, premiums
evidence: DAILY_ACCRUAL interest model; cron default-charges; lib/product-config/non-nca-arrears.ts; monthlyServiceFee
gap: Interest is scheduled, not a daily accrual ledger; IFRS 9 reads it monthly. Default charges and fees exist.

requirement: Statements and enquiries on demand and scheduled, available via API
gap: Staff API and portal PDF only. No statement path in /api/v1 and no scheduled statement.

requirement: SMS and email notices: approval, disbursement, due dates, receipts, rate changes
gap: SMS is OFF by policy (env switch; lib/messaging/.claude.md). No rate-change notice, also missing from #280 and #281.

requirement: Auto closure on settlement, collateral release, clearance certificates
gap: Closure is automatic. Certificate is the NCA s108 one, no LS clearance certificate; collateral release only on asset finance.

requirement: EOD, EOM, EOY batch with automatic restart and recovery
evidence: lib/registry/cron-jobs; cron dpd-update, ifrs9-run; deploy/README.md 'A restart can skip a daily job'
gap: Jobs are separate crons with no batch control. README says most jobs have no catch-up after a restart. No EOY run. Direct contradiction of 'automatic restart'.

requirement: Automatic arrears ageing in configurable DPD buckets, default 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, over 90
gap: Automatic, but hard-coded, and bands are 61-89 and 90+, not the tender's default.

requirement: Early warning: missed salary credits, declining behavioural scores
evidence: None. Grep for early warning and missed salary finds nothing relevant.
gap: Not built. No behavioural score to read.

requirement: Rules-based strategies segmenting accounts to call centre, field and legal queues
evidence: lib/collections/queue.ts (one work list); fixed DPD rules in escalation.ts; AutomationRule
gap: One queue, fixed NCA-shaped stages. No configurable strategy and no field or legal queues.

requirement: Automated SMS, email reminders and letters of demand per strategy
evidence: lib/collections/reminders.ts; section129 on ZA; Section 129 is refused on LS
gap: Main has no LS letter. #289 adds a templated arrears letter, staff-rendered. No strategy drives it, SMS is off.

requirement: Collector workspace, contact history, call outcomes, promises, broken-promise alerts
gap: Workspace is good. Broken status is computed; no alert to the collector found. lib/collections/promiseToPay.ts has no production callers.

requirement: Auto retry of failed debits, sweeping core accounts when funds arrive
evidence: lib/collections-engine (ZA DebiCheck re-presentment, marked unverified against a provider rulebook)
gap: No debit order on LS loans (docs/non-nca-go-live.md) and no core sweep. REST deviation.

requirement: Repayment arrangements and settlement offers with approval workflow
gap: Arrangements exist, no approval step. No settlement offer.

requirement: Handover to legal and external collectors, legal costs, repossession and realisation
gap: Attorney referral exists. Legal cost and repossession are asset finance only. No external collector handover.

requirement: Write-off with approval; recoveries tracked after write-off
evidence: Loan writeOff* fields; WriteOffForm, WriteOffApprovalCard; BAD_DEBT_RECOVERY in lib/accounting/accounts.ts
gap: Check the LS demo walks this route.

requirement: Collections reports: roll rates, cure rates, PTP kept, collector productivity
evidence: reports/decision-performance/tables.tsx (cure, roll, kept by cohort); reports export 'collections'
gap: Figures are decision-cohort analytics, not collections reports. No PTP rate or collector productivity.

requirement: Real-time GL postings by configurable rules; EOD and EOM; daily reconciliation to GL
gap: Journals are made when a month is closed by /api/accounting/periods, not per event in real time. No daily reconciliation job (no accounting cron in lib/registry/cron-jobs).

requirement: IFRS 9 staging, SICR, ECL; classification and reports in CBL formats
gap: docs/ifrs9/DESIGN.md: Central Bank's report layout is not known, workbook is our format. PD and LGD come from the Bank. Clarification Q18.

requirement: Automatic interest suspension on NPLs per CBL requirements
gap: Built and configurable; not checked against a CBL directive, none supplied. Q18.

requirement: Portfolio reports, dashboards, user report builder, PDF, XLSX, CSV
evidence: app/api/reports/export (XLSX, many types); lib/reports/par.ts; reports pages, board-pack
gap: No report builder. Report export is XLSX; CSV and PDF only for isolated items.

requirement: Complete, unalterable audit trail with user, time, action, before and after
evidence: lib/audit.ts; lib/audit (append-only triggers, keyed chain, verifier); docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
gap: Depends on separate web and worker logins in deployment. Before values are only as complete as each caller.

requirement: AI underwriting insights across application, bureau, statement and transaction data, explained; staff decide
gap: Advisory AI reads statements only, and explains flags with code, not a model. No AI risk recommendation over application and bureau data.

requirement: Document extraction and validation for payslips, statements, IDs, financials; tamper detection
evidence: lib/vlm-extract.ts; lib/ocr; lib/statement-analysis (PDF revisions, balance); tamper-fixtures.test.ts
gap: No financial statement extraction. Tamper detection is statement-focused. Expense labelling gate FAILED earlier and its flags are off. Needs VLM in the Bank's environment. ID validation is SA-specific.

requirement: AI drafting of credit memos, committee papers, offer letters, correspondence
evidence: None. lib/statement-ai/.claude.md rules out model prose by design.
gap: Not built; committee pack is assembled by code. Plan tier B.

requirement: AI governance: documentation, performance and bias monitoring, versioning, switch-off, data stays, no third-party training
evidence: featureStatementAi toggle; promptVersion; self-hosted VLM_API_URL; reports/decision-performance; docs/learning-loop/DESIGN.md
gap: Switch-off and self-hosting hold. No bias monitoring, no model documentation pack. The clause applies item 4 tokenization to AI data, so it inherits the 4.2 automatic Fail.

requirement: Graphical drag-and-drop designer for flows, forms, rules and notifications, with versioning, test and maker-checker
evidence: None. Only drag code is the CRM kanban (components/crm/KanbanColumn.tsx). No flow engine; lifecycle is hard-coded.
gap: Not built. Rule and matrix forms cover part of it through maker-checker; forms and flows do not. Q20.

requirement: Low-code API connectors and data mapping without custom development
gap: Not built.

requirement: Expose and consume REST APIs documented in OpenAPI 3.0 or equivalent; submit the docs
gap: Literal line met. Surface is only 4 resources, read-only except draft applications; see 3.3 and 5.4. Attach the JSON.

requirement: Real-time two-way REST integration with core banking
evidence: docs/non-nca-go-live.md (not built); lib/payouts/registry.ts is the seam for payouts only
gap: No core connector, inbound or outbound, no mock. System unknown to us. Automatic Fail if deviated. Q12.

requirement: REST with internet, mobile and USSD for applications, eligibility, status, balance, statements, repayments
gap: No eligibility, statement or repayment endpoint, no USSD. Status and balance only. Automatic Fail.

requirement: REST with ERP for journals, reporting and reconciliation
gap: Adapters are REST but month-close pushes, unproven against real systems (IsaFlow against a fake), and not the Bank's ERP, which is unknown. REST deviation. Q12.

requirement: REST with bureaus, mobile money, payroll employers, SMS and email
gap: Email only is usable. No mobile money, no payroll, no Lesotho bureau; SMS off. Q14.

requirement: OAuth 2.0 or OIDC, mTLS, key management, rate limiting, IP allowlisting
evidence: lib/lender-api/oauth; oauth/mtls.ts; keys.ts; ip-restriction.ts; settings/api; docs/SSO-AND-OAUTH.md
gap: None material. mTLS needs a proxy configured as documented.

requirement: Idempotency, retry and queues, end-to-end logs, reconciliation reports, no loss or duplication
evidence: lib/payments/idempotency.ts; payout claims; webhook outbox; ApiRequestLog; messaging-retry
gap: Good primitives, but no retry queue for bank integrations, which do not exist, and no integration reconciliation report. Scored Fail under the REST deviation rule; the primitives make it close.

requirement: API sandbox and integration support for all interfaces
gap: Simulators exist, no standing partner sandbox. A commitment plus a hosted instance closes it.

requirement: PCI DSS 4.0.1: QSA AOC, or validation listing, or QSA-reviewed responsibility matrix
evidence: None. No PCI document in docs. No QSA engaged.
gap: No evidence, no QSA, no route chosen. PCI is never 'or equivalent'. Cheapest honest route is on-prem with no PAN in scope, with a QSA-reviewed matrix. Q16.

requirement: Tokens replace PAN, account and ID numbers in storage, logs, reports, non-prod, integration messages; logged detokenization
evidence: None. idNumber and bankAccountNumber are plain String columns (prisma/schema/clients-kyc.prisma); SIEM field minimiser only (lib/audit/siem/minimise.ts)
gap: No tokenization. Touches every read of those fields, including PDFs and matching. Automatic Fail.

requirement: Secure token vault, segregated, encrypted, separately managed keys
gap: No vault. Automatic Fail. Buy (Vault Transform or equivalent) rather than build.

requirement: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+, keys in HSM FIPS 140-2/3 L3 or equivalent KMS
evidence: lib/crypto/secret-box.ts, lib/storage-crypto.ts (AES-256-GCM for secrets and uploads); gpg AES256 backups; TLS at ingress
gap: Database columns are not encrypted by us (relies on volume encryption). Keys are env variables; no HSM or KMS code. docs/DEPLOY.md: rotation not covered. Automatic Fail.

requirement: RBAC, SoD, maker-checker on sensitive changes, MFA, SSO or LDAP
gap: RBAC, MFA and SSO are met. Maker-checker does not cover every parameter: product edits until #280, and TenantConfig and many settings stay single-person. Sockpuppet rule needs #292.

requirement: Role-based masking on screens and reports; PAN at most first 6, last 4
evidence: maskIdNumber in lib/lender-api/serializers.ts; maskAccountNumber in lib/asset-finance/supplier-bank-view.ts; lib/security/client-redaction.ts
gap: Full ID shown to staff at app/(dashboard)/clients/[id]/page.tsx:354, no role-based mask there. No PAN stored (no field for it), which needs stating.

requirement: Tamper-evident logs forwarded to SIEM, kept 12 months, 3 months immediately available
evidence: lib/audit; lib/audit/siem; cron audit-chain-verify, audit-siem-deliver; AuditPolicy minimum 12 months; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
gap: Retention is recorded policy; nothing deletes, so it holds. Demo needs a SIEM endpoint. Worker login separation required.

requirement: ASVS or Top 10 aligned SDLC, independent annual pen test, critical patches in 30 days
evidence: CI Semgrep, npm audit, gitleaks, Trivy (.github/workflows/security.yml)
gap: No independent pen test (T3 requires a summary under 12 months old), no ASVS mapping, no patch policy document.

requirement: Valid ISO/IEC 27001 held by bidder or publisher, and by the hosting provider
evidence: Certificate not seen. Plan says Fair Score brings it.
gap: Attach Fair Score's certificate, and check its scope covers software delivery. Q5 on whether a JV member suffices. Hosting provider too if not on-prem.

requirement: Lesotho Data Protection Act 2011 and CBL requirements; Bank owns its data
evidence: DSAR, breach log, consent modules are POPIA-built; lib/jurisdiction
gap: No reference to the Act anywhere in repo or docs. No legal mapping. Ownership is a contract term.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: Cloud-native; same solution on-prem, public cloud or SaaS; state model; no lift and shift
gap: Helm chart is one path for all models, kind-tested only, never on a real cloud or Bank platform. Uploads depend on a shared PVC. An assessor may read one Next.js app as not re-architected.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: Independently deployable, scalable microservices per business function; failure isolation
evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; one image, web and worker Deployments
gap: Modular monolith, one deployable, one database. Not microservices. 'Or equivalent' needs proof and failure isolation is not provable. Q9.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: OCI containers on Kubernetes with self-healing and rolling updates
evidence: Dockerfile; deploy/helm/credaflow web-deployment, worker-deployment, pdb, hpa; deploy-lint.yml
gap: Met for web. Worker is one replica with Recreate, not rolling; declare it as a minor deviation.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: Every function, incl. those used by the UI, on documented versioned REST APIs; 6 months' notice
evidence: 582 route.ts under app/api; 10 under /api/v1 in OpenAPI
gap: About 2% of routes are documented or versioned; much UI uses server actions. Not API-first. REST deviation. Automatic Fail.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: Automatic horizontal scaling of individual services
evidence: templates/hpa.yaml: web 2-6 on CPU; shared Postgres rate-limit store
gap: Web tier only; worker must stay at one replica.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: CI/CD, automated tests, code and image scanning, zero-downtime releases
gap: CI and scanning are strong. No CD pipeline. Zero-downtime only for expand/contract migrations (deploy/README.md).

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: Centralised logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards and alerts for the Bank
evidence: lib/observability; deploy/monitoring grafana-dashboard.json, prometheus-alerts.yaml; OTLP export
gap: Parts are shipped, off by default. Log store, Prometheus and tracing backend are not supplied, DB queries are not traced. Run the stack once and screenshot it.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: Bank-approved region, CBL rules, ISO and PCI of provider, audit right, data export at exit
evidence: On-prem per bid plan; pg_dump backups; DSAR export for individuals
gap: On-prem settles residency. No exit export tool in standard formats; audit right and CBL outsourcing are contract items.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: Browser access with no workstation install
gap: Cross-browser check not recorded. Run it before claiming 'all major browsers'.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: Separate Prod, DR, UAT, Training; non-prod holds no untokenized live data
evidence: One Helm release per environment; synthetic seeds (prisma/seed.ts)
gap: Environments are not defined or sized. Clause cannot be met by tokens; only by a no-live-data rule until 4.2 is built.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: 500,000 loans, 300 concurrent users, 20% growth over 5 years
evidence: None. No load test, k6 or benchmark in the repo.
gap: Never measured. Nightly per-loan sweeps and PAR queries are unproven at that scale. T4 requires a benchmark.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: 3 s online for 95%, 2 s API for 95% at peak, EOD within 2 hours
evidence: Only a p95 alert in deploy/monitoring/prometheus-alerts.yaml
gap: Never measured.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: 99.9% monthly availability
gap: Commitment with no record behind it. One worker and no database HA design. Depends on 5.14.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: Active redundancy, automatic failover, RPO 15 min or less, RTO 4 h or less
evidence: Nightly pg_dump only (docs/DEPLOY.md); restore-drill.sh reports timings
gap: Nightly dump is an RPO of up to 24 h. No replica, WAL archiving or failover design or test in the repo. T4 requires a DR design.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: Automated encrypted daily backups in a separate location, tested restores
gap: Strong on single host. docs/DEPLOY.md: copying off-host is not done, no cron installed. No Kubernetes backup path.

section: 5 Technical Architecture, Performance and Business Continuity
requirement: Commercially supported or cloud-managed DB; licences in bid price
gap: Community Postgres on its own is not 'commercially supported'. Needs a support quote or managed service and Q10.

requirement: Project plan and Gantt consistent with the schedule
evidence: None for the bid. Tender's own schedule has no periods (Q24).
gap: Document not written. Cheap.

requirement: Migration of active and closed loans, 100% balance reconciliation, 99.5% accuracy
gap: No loan import tool and no method document. Source system unknown (Q23).

requirement: End-user, admin and train-the-trainer training, English materials
gap: In-app course exists, written for ZA flows. No training plan.

requirement: User, admin, technical and API documentation in English
gap: Technical docs are good. No user manual or admin manual as a document; T1 also asks for manuals.

requirement: 12 months' warranty; 24/7 Sev 1, 1h response, 4h fix; Sev 2 in 4h
gap: No SLA, no 24/7 rota. Needs staffed support, not only a document.

requirement: All updates included in bid price
gap: Commercial statement to add to the bid.

requirement: 3 LMS implementations at banks or regulated institutions in 5 years, 1 integrated with core banking by API
evidence: Ndzinga only on our side, without a core integration; Fair Score's references not seen
gap: We have at most one, and none with core banking. Rests wholly on Fair Score. Q6.

requirement: Software Publisher's Authorisation where the Bidder is not the publisher
gap: Depends on whether the JV includes the publisher entity, and on who owns CredaFlow in the JV. Q8.

requirement: Signed CVs: PM (PMP or PRINCE2), Integration Lead (2 core banking integrations), Security Lead (CISSP, CISM or CISA)
gap: No named people. Integration Lead with core banking REST experience is the hard one.
